what: The furniture set: what a furniture brand files to import and sell (src/forms/furniture.ts) and what its plan states beyond the filings (src/forms/kinds.ts, kinds furniture, upholstered, storage, children, china and cnbedroom). An upholstered brand importing into Los Angeles with showrooms in California and New York (two cases, one per showroom), a case-goods brand importing dressers into New Jersey, an upholstered brand importing sofas from Vietnam into Los Angeles, a brand importing Chinese wooden bedroom furniture into New Jersey, a children's furniture line importing into Denver, and an upholstered brand expanding to the EU (Paris) and to Great Britain (London).
researched: 2026-10-21, from official pages only, each quote re-read with scripts/eval/proof-read.py. Second pass: the ISF from 19 CFR part 149 and the bond from 19 CFR parts 142 and 113 on GovInfo (CBP's own pages refuse automated reads); the Section 232, Section 301, antidumping and UFLPA notices from the Federal Register on GovInfo; CPSC's certificate and tracking label pages; OEHHA's furniture fact sheet; Ohio's rule 4101:6-1-03; CalRecycle, Oregon DEQ and CDPHE for packaging EPR; the Commission's environment pages for the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUR-Lex refuses curl); gov.uk and legislation.gov.uk for Great Britain.

left_out.what: New York and New Jersey upholstered furniture or stuffed article registrations
left_out.why: No official New York or New Jersey page found states one. Massachusetts's, Pennsylvania's and Ohio's are stated, from their own pages.

left_out.what: California retail furniture dealer's license fee
left_out.why: BHGS's retailer application wasn't found on its site; the fee is left to the agency.

left_out.what: General Certificate of Conformity eFiling for every regulated product
left_out.why: The general row (cpsc-cert) also serves non-furniture importers and has no quote that limits it to regulated consumer products, so it abstains; the children's certificate and the clothing storage unit certificate are claimed from their own pages.

left_out.what: French and UK company, tax and EORI filings
left_out.why: Not read on an official page in this pass: the rows abstain and name the office; the EU and GB product rules are scored as facts.

left_out.what: Antidumping rates for named exporters and Section 301 exclusions
left_out.why: Exporter-specific; the plan states the China-wide 216.01 percent cash deposit and says to confirm the exporter's own rate.

left_out.what: Other states' packaging EPR (Maine, Minnesota, Maryland, Washington)
left_out.why: Only California, Oregon and Colorado were read in this pass.
